title: GitCloneRequest
description: One 'Clone to my computer' request from a repository page on OpenVibe.Git. Git mints it for the signed-in person and keeps it for two minutes. The person's Link reads it over an outbound HTTPS relay with the one-time token in the link, asks the person there, clones owner/name into a folder inside the root the person chose in Link, and reports progress back. The page polls the same document. clone_url is present only in the answer to the Link (it carries a short-lived read token) and never in the page's copy.

id.description: The request's own id (clr_<ULID>), also the Link's idempotency key.

repo.description: owner/name, lower-case, exactly as the repository page names it.

state.description: pending until the person answers in Link; approved when they say yes; cloning while git runs; done, refused, failed or expired after that. A request past expires_at is expired, whatever the stored state.

clone_url.description: The HTTPS clone URL with a read-only, short-lived Git token, sent to the Link only. Never returned to the page.

expires_at.description: created_at + two minutes. Link refuses to start a clone after this.

line.description: One line of git's own progress, with any token removed.

path.description: Where Link put the clone, only when state is done.

reason.description: Why it was refused or failed, in words the page can show.
